movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Constrict
movelist.effect: Constrict lowers the target’s Speed 1 Combat Stage. Constrict may be used as a Swift Action against targets the user is Grappling, and automatically hits when performed this way.

movelist.name: Ingrain
movelist.effect: Ingrain applies a Coat to the user, which has the following effect; the user cannot be pushed or pulled, and cannot be switched out.  At the beginning of each of the user’s turn, the user gains a Tick of Hit Points.

movelist.name: Acid
movelist.effect: Acid lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 18+.

movelist.name: Ancient Power
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Suction Cups
abilities.effect: The user gains +5 Damage Reduction for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Storm Drain
abilities.effect: The Move is turned into a 1-Target Move and is re-directed at the user without fail, and cannot miss. This negates Lock-On or Mind Reader.  the user’s Special Attack is then raised by +1 Combat Stage.
